protocol.primary_evaluation: stochastic capped policy on fixed heldout Level2 distribution
protocol.orientation: Excluded: hardware reliability unconfirmed; separate future ablation only
protocol.deployability: Angle encoder, reset reference, calibrated fixture position, finger contact assumed measurable; hardware verification still required
protocol.fixture_randomization: Rigid cabinet XYZ translation, not independent reshaping of the handle
protocol.inference: 5 seed paired t confidence intervals and exact sign-flip tests; Holm family correction; no episode pseudoreplication
protocol.evaluation: Fixed Level2 AUC every 10k, separate nominal preservation; independent heldout 64 episodes/mode/condition at best/final
protocol.conditional_tests: Sensor noise and input masking only if D improves randomized success over A and preserves nominal >=90%
protocol.randomization: Independent per-environment RNG, common seed streams; actual exposures may differ under identical adaptive curriculum
protocol.prior_costs: Additional interactions only; all inherited data and Phase9 training costs disclosed separately

pilot_decision.reason: Direct Level2 pilot below 80% or rejected update
pilot_decision.rule: Same controller every arm: start Level0, advance one level only after two disjoint 64-episode policy evaluations both >=80%; retain episode boundaries
pilot_decision.limitation: Adaptive realized exposure can differ; identical random seeds and controller; fixed Level2 heldout is primary. Any effect includes state-mediated curriculum progression.

conditional_gate.rule: D-A randomized final paired t95 lower >0, at least4/5 favorable, D nominal mean >=90%
conditional_gate.status: Deferred: D did not meet prespecified randomized improvement and nominal preservation gate

statistical_notes: Seed is inferential unit; t CI unbounded, model-dependent with n=5
Two-sided exact sign-flip minimum p is0.0625 for5 nonzero pairs; episode count does not overcome seed replication
Predeclared adaptive controller is identical, realized difficulty exposure may differ; fixed Level2 test is primary
